issues.title: Add button for tutorial, move heartbeat icon
issues.body:
We show the walkthrough for new users, but they can't trigger it later on.  How to re-open the walkthrough is covered in #840 

We will add a `Tutorial` button to the player interface.  It will use the `book-open` fontawesome icon used in #840.  The icon will go in the place of the current `heartbeat` icon.

The `heartbeat` icon will move down to the bottom-left version details.  The icon will go to the left of the `App` text here:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/122540582-b2123280-d020-11eb-895b-c249cc8e57c9.png)

comments.body:
